title: Luxury Design -Close to Downtown Broadway & Coffee
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this spacious and conveniently located condo! Located in the hip & trendy East Nashville neighborhood. Walk to local coffee shops, restaurants & a brewery. Only 10 minutes to Downtown Broadway bars + Nissan Stadium and 13 min to the Grand Ole Opry! Hair salon in the building if you need a quick cut. Fully equipped kitchen, Smart TVs in both bedrooms + living room. Washer/dryer in unit, plus Free parking available. Condo is on the 1st floor with no stairs to climb.

The space

★ Only 10 min drive to Downtown Broadway Bars
★ Only 13 min drive to the Grand Ole Opry
★ In-unit washer/dryer (free to use)

★ Plenty of storage space for your clothes
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Adjustable thermostat
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Keurig Coffee Maker & K-Cups
★ Located on the 1st floor - no stairs to climb
★ Walking distance to All People Coffee, Southern Grist Brewery, Redheaded Stranger, Folk, Audrey, & more! 
★ Two Grocery stores nearby - Publix and Kroger

BEDS: 
Bedroom 1: 1 King 
Bedroom 2: 1 Queen
Living Room: Full-Size Sleeper Sofa and 1 Twin size Rollaway Bed with a memory foam mattress

BATHROOMS: 
Bathroom 1: Full size with stand up shower connected to bedroom #1
Bathroom 2: Full size with shower/tub combo in a hallway next to bedroom #2

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this spacious and inviting condo. The space provides the perfect mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. Our neighborhood is very safe and charming with many beloved spots in this flourishing local area of East Nashville. The airport is only about 15 minutes away. There are plenty of Ubers, Lyft and taxis available if you choose not to bring a car. Our condo is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer!
